verdict.rationale: Yapily documents generic transaction categorisation, merchant detection, and spending insights built on account/transaction data (yapily-docs-3, yapily-docs-15, yapily-docs-28), which is adjacent to income/cash-flow signal derivation, but there is no evidence of dedicated recurring-income/payroll detection or a documented income verification product. Missing for 10: explicit recurring income/payroll detection logic, dedicated income verification API/product, and any documentation tying categorisation to cash-flow or income signals specifically.
